repair_rationale: Run 003 exposed an admission-boundary defect: the harness validated language and generic machine controls but did not bind Luna's event to the exact frozen teacher turn. It therefore admitted generic WORKED_* summaries for the initial presentation, and the first PRESENT_AGAIN replay later failed because Luna serialized the wrong phase, delivery mode, text, and script reference. The harness now requires canonical exercise/teacher_turn_N references, exact text and delivery mode, unique ordinal emission, and an exact one-turn replay before a cold retest. The conductor prompt decomposes PRESENT_AGAIN into three separately linted artifacts. Because the blind verdict also identified a Luna routine failure at medium, the conductor advances exactly one effort rung to high; lesson bytes, visuals, learner profile, scenario, and scoring thresholds remain unchanged.
